verdict.rationale: Plausible publishes a documented Events API for sending pageviews/custom events and a Stats API (including a v2 query endpoint with scoped API keys) for programmatic access, which together constitute a documented public API that an AI-native user or agent could drive. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec or machine-readable llms.txt/docs.md was found (probes returned 404), and there's no evidence of official SDKs or agent-specific tooling. Missing for 10: machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/Swagger), llms.txt, and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage by AI agents.
